defs.def: feeling ashamed because you have done sth that you know is wrong or have not done sth that you should have done 感到内疚的；感到惭愧的

ex.s: But he never feels guilty about the harm he is doing.
ex.t: 但他从不为自己造成的伤害感到内疚。

ex.s: Although it was completely innocent, Claire felt guilty.
ex.t: 虽然这件事完全是无辜的，但克莱尔感到内疚。

ex.s: This 35 worried me a lot and I felt very guilty being a rich man without doing anything." Therefore he gave away all his moneyto charities.
ex.t: 这让我很担心，我觉得做一个什么都不做的富人很内疚。因此他把所有的钱都捐给了慈善机构。

ex.s: This worried me a lot and I felt very guilty being a rich man without doing anything.
ex.t: 这让我很担心，我觉得做一个什么都不做的富人很内疚。

defs.def: having done sth illegal; being responsible for sth bad that has happened 犯了罪；有过失的；有罪责的

ex.s: Oh no, the common man is every bit as guilty; otherwise, people and nations would have rebelled long ago!
ex.t: 哦不，普通人同样有罪；否则，人民和各国早就起义反抗了！
